notes.title: An update!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37267404/c02033218d96824fe0ad1f49217e7ea416f49151.png"]

Holy Macaroni, an update! The game was okie-dokie, but now it's awesome-sauce!



What's new:

-Completely new opening, and half new ending

-Some annoying action scenes are improved/simplified

-Baby metroid will help you thrice!

-Alternative way to defeat the 3rd final boss form (just wait for baby metroid)

-Some new visual effects here and there



I hope more will come in the future,

Ark
